therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndrome, biomarker-directed based on RARA super-enhancer associated biomarker and IRF8 biomarker
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Response Rate (ORR) in biomarker positive AML or HR-MDS participants and Transfusion Independence Rate (TIR) for LR-MDS participants

results.effect_size: ORR: 12/12 RARA-positive ND AML with tamibarotene+azacitidine, 4/4 R/R AML with tamibarotene+azacitidine, 2/2 R/R AML/HR-MDS with tamibarotene monotherapy, 0/0 LR-MDS TIR with tamibarotene monotherapy
biomarker_changes: RARA super-enhancer associated biomarker positive patients showed responses
IRF8 biomarker positive/RARA negative patients: 2 responses
subgroup_findings: RARA-positive ND AML: median OS 8.4 months, median DOR 10.8 months
RARA-negative ND AML: median OS 11.7 months, median DOR 4.7 months
R/R AML with azacitidine: median OS 5.9 months, median DOR 5.9 months
results.dose_information: oral tablets, specific dosing not provided

context.comparator: none (single-arm study with multiple treatment cohorts)
